name: ghotok
description: Ghotok (ghotok.com.bd) — matchmaking platform for every faith in Bangladesh

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @ghotok/api & npm run dev --workspace @ghotok/web & npm run dev --workspace @ghotok/admin & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ghotok/web && npm run build --workspace @ghotok/admin
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @ghotok/shared && npm run test --workspace @ghotok/web && npm run test --workspace @ghotok/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace @ghotok/shared && npm run test --workspace @ghotok/web
